source.body:
### Bug Description

The binary file preview modal shows several English strings that do not go through i18n:

- the modal title "File Preview"
- "Loading binary data..." and "Error loading binary data"
- "Preview not available for this file type"
- the image fallback alt text "Image preview"

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ndv/runData/components/BinaryDataViewModal.vue#L135-L197

The same loading and error text is hardcoded in `BinaryDataDisplayEmbed.vue`, and the same alt text in `BinaryEntryDataTable.vue`:

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ndv/runData/components/BinaryDataDisplayEmbed.vue#L59-L60
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ndv/runData/components/BinaryEntryDataTable.vue#L88

Other text in the same modal already uses i18n, for example `binaryDataDisplay.yourBrowserDoesNotSupport`. The PDF iframe in the modal already uses `binaryDataDisplay.filePreview` for its title, while the modal title next to it is a literal.

### To Reproduce

1. Switch the instance UI to a language other than English.
2. Run a workflow that outputs an image, for example an HTTP Request node that downloads one.
3. Open the output in the NDV and click **View** on the binary item.
4. The modal title reads "File Preview" in English.

### Expected behavior

All text in the binary preview uses i18n keys and shows in the active language.

### Debug Info

Found by reading the source on `master` (version `2.44.0`). The strings are hardcoded in the component, so this does not depend on the instance setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.44.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a PR ready for this.
